en: Black‑and‑white historical postcard showing a rural dirt road lined with wooden fences in front of wooden farm buildings or an inn. Two men stand with a horse on the left side of the road, while two women in long skirts and shawls stand on the right. In the background are additional buildings and a small church or similar structure. Printed captions in Finnish and Swedish describe the scene and its connection to the 1808–1809 war. A handwritten note at the top right reads "v. 1908".
